svg.title: Растяжка широчайших у опоры — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. ONE figure only. Kneeling supported lat stretch, side three-quarter view. Knees and shins rest on floor, hips shift back toward heels, torso inclines forward and head aligns between arms. Both arms reach straight forward and hands visibly rest on top of a stable low bench with full bench shown. Do not kneel on bench. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
